The session mostly followed the procedure, with one gap: some documents and code were checked only through grep matches rather than read.

- **Shallow reading:** the procedure says to read what the search finds and to read the code lines far enough to tell. Per the final summary (turn 22), the loop-issues spec, the engine-cli spec and the guide were seen only as grep matches, and the engine code was checked by search only. Turns 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 17 and 18 are all greps. The gaps are seven, so the "findable" and "Covered by" judgments rest partly on snippets.
- **Unresolved conversation value:** the prompt carries the literal placeholder `⟨missing:settings.conversation⟩`. The Owner decisions and Findable rules depend on that value. The turns shown do not say how the session handled it, and the prompt never says what to do when it is missing.
- **Capability list:** turn 7 only globbed `.tempergraph/capabilities.md` (28 chars, just the path), and no read of it appears. Whether the later greps covered it is not visible, so I am not flagging this.
